basic_details.job_title: DCPU Buxar Support Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 15 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: 30 to 65 years (as on from the date of publication of advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate in Social Work (MSW) / Sociology / Psychology / Child Development or Law, OR Graduate in any stream with Diploma in Child Rights/Counseling along with 3 years experience.
qualification.details: Other conditions: | Must be a citizen of India Must be a resident of Buxar district Should not be convicted of moral turpitude | Desirable: | Working experience in District Legal Services Authority / State Legal Services Authority / District Child Protection Unit / Child Welfare Committee / Juvenile Justice Board / POCSO Court or Childline / Child Helpline services will be given priority

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 9000 per month per POCSO case (in 3 installments)

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format from the website https://buxar.nic.in.
Fill in all details clearly in capital letters and attach self-attested copies of all educational, experience, caste, identity, and residential certificates.
Send the filled application form mentioning the post name through registered post or speed post to the given address within 21 days of advertisement publication.
Make sure it reaches by 21 November 2026.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date or in incomplete format will be rejected Original copies of all certificates must be brought on the date of interview Information regarding interview dates and lists will be published on the district website and office notice board

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Must be a citizen of India Must be a resident of Buxar district Should not be convicted of moral turpitude Desirable: Working experience in District Legal Services Authority / State Legal Services Authority / District Child Protection Unit / Child Welfare Committee / Juvenile Justice Board / POCSO Court or Childline / Child Helpline services will be given priority

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DCPU Buxar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Anyone with a criminal case registered against them anywhere in India. Anyone ever found guilty of moral turpitude. Anyone expelled or blacklisted by an institution working in child protection or child development.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary empanelment for a period of two years

rows.event: Last Date for Submission of Application

content_sections.heading: How Will DCPU Buxar Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on educational qualification Interview by Selection Committee Evaluation based on educational qualifications: Graduation - 50 marks, Post Graduation - 20 marks, Ph.D. - 10 marks, Total academic - 80 marks Interview - Maximum 20 marks

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Experience certificate Caste certificate Identity card (Aadhaar / PAN / Voter ID) Residential certificate Affidavit regarding no criminal case and no conviction for moral turpitude Affidavit regarding not being expelled or blacklisted Passport size recent photograph affixed on application

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date or in incomplete format will be rejected Original copies of all certificates must be brought on the date of interview Information regarding interview dates and lists will be published on the district website and office notice board

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Buxar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DCPU Buxar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies for Support Person.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DCPU Buxar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (https://buxar.nic.in) and send it to Assistant Director, District Child Protection Unit, Collectorate Complex, Buxar, Pin-802101, by registered post or speed post, to reach by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 to 65 years (as on from the date of publication of advertisement).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 9000 per month per POCSO case (in 3 installments).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate in Social Work (MSW) / Sociology / Psychology / Child Development or Law, OR Graduate in any stream with Diploma in Child Rights/Counseling along with 3 years experience.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India. Must be a resident of Buxar district. Should not be convicted of moral turpitude.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Anyone with a criminal case registered against them anywhere in India. Anyone ever found guilty of moral turpitude. Anyone expelled or blacklisted by an institution working in child protection or child development.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on educational qualification. Interview by Selection Committee. Evaluation based on educational qualifications: Graduation - 50 marks, Post Graduation - 20 marks, Ph.D. - 10 marks, Total academic - 80 marks. Interview - Maximum 20 marks.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary empanelment for a period of two years.
